preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(3 <= n <= 1000 and n <= m <= min((n*(n-1))//2, 2000) for n, m in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of caves n is between 3 and 1000, and the number of tunnels m is between n and the minimum of (n*(n-1))/2 and 2000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 10**9 for test_case in test_cases for a_i in test_case['a_values'])
preconditions.description: For each test case, each value a_i in the list of monster powers is between 1 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= b_i <= 10**9 for test_case in test_cases for b_i in test_case['b_values'])
preconditions.description: For each test case, each value b_i in the list of power increases is between 1 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= u_i <= n and 1 <= v_i <= n and u_i != v_i for u_i, v_i in test_case['tunnels']) for test_case in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, each tunnel connects two distinct caves, and each cave number is between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(tunnel)) == 2 for test_case in test_cases for tunnel in test_case['tunnels'])
preconditions.description: For each test case, each tunnel connects two distinct caves without self-loops.

preconditions.expression: all(len(test_case['tunnels']) == m for test_case, m in zip(test_cases, [test_case['m'] for test_case in test_cases]))
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of tunnels m matches the provided list of tunnels.

preconditions.expression: all(len(test_case['a_values']) == n-1 for test_case, n in zip(test_cases, [test_case['n'] for test_case in test_cases]))
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of monster power values a_i is n-1.

preconditions.expression: all(len(test_case['b_values']) == n-1 for test_case, n in zip(test_cases, [test_case['n'] for test_case in test_cases]))
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of power increase values b_i is n-1.

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(tunnel)) == 2 for test_case in test_cases for tunnel in test_case['tunnels'])
preconditions.description: For each test case, each tunnel connects two distinct caves without self-loops.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result, int) and result >= 1 for result in results)
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is a single integer representing the smallest possible starting power, which is at least 1.

postconditions.expression: all(can_pass_level(test_case, result) for test_case, result in zip(test_cases, results))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output power is sufficient for the hero to beat all monsters and pass the level.
